Rashi on Zevachim 17b:1:1.english: He holds - Rabba, who expounds this teaching to say that all of them are necessary.

Rashi on Zevachim 17b:1:2.hebrew: מחוסר כפורים דזב כזב - ה"ה למצורע, אלא חד מנייהו נקט. מחוסר כפורים דזב כזב דמי לענין קדשים, שלא הותר אצלו; הוה ליה כאילו לא טבל, ואם אכלו — חייב כרת, או אם נגע בהו — טמאן, למנות בהן ראשון ושני. לכך לא קלשה טומאה אצל קדשים כלל:
Rashi on Zevachim 17b:1:2.english: One lacking atonement is like a zav - The same applies to a leper, but [the Gemara] mentioned only one of them. One who lacks atonement is considered like a zav with regard to sacred things, for [the sacred things] were not permitted to him; it is as if he had not immersed. If he ate them, he is liable to karet; or if he touched them, he renders them impure, so as to count in them a first[-degree impurity] and a second[-degree impurity]. Therefore, impurity is not weakened at all with regard to sacred things.

Rashi on Zevachim 17b:2:1.hebrew: שרפה אונן כו' - בפרה אדומה קאי:
Rashi on Zevachim 17b:2:1.english: [If] an acute mourner burned [it], etc. - This is referring to the red heifer.
